major_workstreams_and_themes.description: Core technical and functional workstreams driving delivery forward.

roadmap_horizon_and_timeframes.description: Overall chronological span covering major release windows and delivery horizons.

release_2_scope_and_milestone.description: Target completion date and expanded functionality for subsequent release phases.

cross_project_and_external_dependencies.description: Critical interdependencies with other organizational initiatives, platforms, or vendors.

critical_architectural_and_strategic_ass.description: Foundational assumptions underpinning delivery timelines and resource models.

strategic_risks_and_mitigation.description: Major strategic risks that could impact timeline execution and roadmap milestones.
